newsitem.title: UK: LME lists new lead brand, delists another.
newsitem.headline: LME lists new lead brand, delists another.

text.p: The London Metal Exchange (LME) has listed the HAMCO lead brand produced at Hamco Mining and Smelting Ltd's plant at Silvassa in India.
The brand will constitute good delivery against LME contracts with immediate effect.
At the same time the LME gave notice of the delisting of the Mexican brand IMM CHIHUAHUA produced by Industria Minera Mexico SA.
No further deliveries of this brand will be accepted for LME warranting from August 12 and once stocks are exhausted the brand will be delisted, the LME notice said.
